chunks.title: Histograms and scatterplots
chunks.text: Daily returns are one of the most important factors for us to consider when looking at market statistics.

chunks.title: Histograms and scatterplots
chunks.text: But daily returns for a single stock just by themselves are not very informative.

chunks.title: Histograms and scatterplots
chunks.text: One of the most informative ways to consider daily returns is when we compare the returns of one stock with another.
